categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration and determinations under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed schedules of land parcels with ownership information, property boundaries, and title settlements for specific plots in Kurunegala District. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazettes category as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and title settlements administered by the Commissioner General of Land Title Settlement.
